actors.name: Calloway Regional Hospital employees
actors.private_context: Each employee has their own workload, interest in the survey, and personal schedule during the two-week window. They may or may not remember to complete the survey.

actors.name: HR department
actors.private_context: HR wants a high response rate and has prepared the survey. They can send reminders and track completion, but cannot force participation.

shared_context: The annual engagement survey is open from 2026-09-01T08:00:00-05:00 to 2026-09-15T17:00:00-05:00. All 400 employees are eligible. The survey is accessible via a link sent by email. HR can send reminders during the period.

starting_events.description: HR sends the initial survey invitation email to all 400 employees.

resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least 60 employees submitted a completed survey response before the cutoff. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
